findings.excerpt: title: "Successive p-multiple layers recover the summands of C_p^2 times C_{p^3} times C_{p^4}^2"
findings.symptom: The rendered title exposes raw underscores, braces, and carets in the cyclic-group orders.
findings.suggested_repair: Use inline math for the displayed group, e.g. $C_p^2	imes C_{p^3}	imes C_{p^4}^2$.

findings.excerpt: [L1] Suppose $G\cong\prod_{j<r}C_{p^{e_j}}$ with $e_j\ge1$, and in additive notation write $p^iG=\{p^ig:g\in G\}$. Define $d_i$ by $|p^iG/p^{i+1}G|=p^{d_i}$. Then $$d_i=|\{j:e_j\ge i+1\}|.$$ Consequently, for every $k\ge1$, the number of summands of order $p^k$ is $d_{k-1}-d_k$, so the elementary divisors are intrinsic. ([[lem-successive-p-multiple-quotients-recover-elementary-divisors]]).
findings.symptom: The linked item title is displayed literally as “p^iG/p^{i+1}G”, exposing carets and braces instead of typeset powers.
findings.suggested_repair: Give the internal link an explicit math-formatted label or revise the linked item title to use inline math delimiters.
